name: Drawing Sword Reflects Peach Blossom
original_name: Drawing Sword Reflects Peach Blossom (提剑映桃花)
overview: “The Drawing Sword Reflects Peach Blossom” (提剑映桃花) is a 2025 Chinese short drama blending costume mystery, detective comedy, and tragedy.  It premiered on Tencent Video on 28 July 2025, with a 15‑minute episode format, starring Wanyan Luorong, Liu Haoqun, and Han Leyao.  The story revolves around a murder at Peach Blossom Manor, where hidden secrets and selfish motives lead to a tragic ending.
